question:
Find the value of x in the following equation.

45% of 360 + 30% of 400 = 25% of x
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a3ba98fe537b71a0cedca8cdf679aea0668b950fa8b6ddc2ea6c6e99a6adff.png] 

**Calculation:**

Here, 45% of 360 + 30% of 400 = 25% of x

⇒ (45 × 360/100) + (30 × 400/100) = (25 × x)/100

⇒ 162 + 120 = x/4

⇒ x/4 = 282

⇒ x = 1128

**∴ The correct answer is 1128.**
